title: pxrd_PEAK: extraction pipeline and website for the Open PXRD Database
description: Code that extracts calibrated powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) curves from figures in published covalent organic framework (COF) papers, combining a vision large language model with classical computer vision, and the website and read-only API of the Open PXRD Database (https://pxrd-peak.vercel.app). The digitized dataset itself is archived as a separate Zenodo record under CC BY 4.0.
